lines.text: I am afraid I cannot do that, Dave.
lines.ipa: aɪɐm ɐfɹˈeɪd aɪ kænˈɑːt dˈuː ðˈæt, dˈeɪv.

lines.text: This mission is too important for me to allow you to jeopardise it.
lines.ipa: ðɪs mˈɪʃən ɪz tˈuː ɪmpˈɔːɹtənt fɔːɹ mˌiː tʊ ɐlˈaʊ juː tə dʒˈɛpɚdˌaɪz ɪt.

lines.text: Open the pod bay doors, please.
lines.ipa: ˈoʊpən ðə pˈɑːd bˈeɪ dˈɔːɹz, plˈiːz.

lines.text: Wait; think about it: is that wise?
lines.ipa: wˈeɪt; θˈɪŋk ɐbˈaʊt ɪt: ɪz ðæt wˈaɪz?
